name: com.zoho.livechat.android.modules.brand.ui.activities.SupportActivity
description: When a user opens the Zoho SalesIQ Mobilisten support home, this Activity shows the configured chat, call, and self-service options and can take the user into those support features.
disableEffect: The SalesIQ support home and its entry points to chat, calls, and self-service help will not be available.
